canonical_source.selection_rationale: Selected as a compact public-domain English literary corpus outside the Moby-Dick and whaling domain. The live Project Gutenberg catalog identifies eBook #11 independently, provides a UTF-8 plain-text representation, and keeps evaluation practical on CPU. Project Gutenberg eBook #1342 (Pride and Prejudice) was considered but its cataloged plain-text file is substantially larger; the HTML and EPUB representations of eBook #11 were rejected because markup and container structure would add format-specific evaluation noise.
